name: settings-root-fills-the-window
description:
The settings window opened with a white band down each side. find.css, loaded by atrium.html on every route, had set body to a fixed centred flex box for the find bar, so the settings grid shrank to its content and sat centred in the window's white body. The rule now lives on #atrium-root.findroot. This reads the settings root's width against the viewport, once at the window's initial size and once after a resize. The width is read against the document's client width: the VM shows scrollbars always, and after the shrink the page grows a 15px document scrollbar that innerWidth counts and the root cannot cover.

axresize sizes the LARGEST window, so the browser window is shrunk to 700x500 before the chord: the 860x620 settings window is then the largest and the second resize lands on it.

actions.note: gate: the startup tab committed, so the app is up
Atrium frontmost, so the chord reaches it
the browser window, so the settings window becomes the largest one
let the route paint at the initial size

actions.expression: (() => { const r = document.getElementById('atrium-root').getBoundingClientRect(); return r.left === 0 && Math.round(r.width) === document.documentElement.clientWidth; })()
actions.note: THE MEASUREMENT: the root starts at the left edge and is as wide as the viewport

actions.expression: (() => { const r = document.getElementById('atrium-root').getBoundingClientRect(); return 'root ' + Math.round(r.left) + '+' + Math.round(r.width) + ' viewport ' + innerWidth + ' client ' + document.documentElement.clientWidth + ' scroll ' + document.documentElement.scrollHeight + '/' + innerHeight; })()

actions.note: the settings window, now the largest

actions.expression: (() => { const r = document.getElementById('atrium-root').getBoundingClientRect(); return innerWidth === 760 && r.left === 0 && Math.round(r.width) === document.documentElement.clientWidth; })()
actions.note: THE MEASUREMENT: the viewport took the new width and the root follows it

actions.expression: (() => { const r = document.getElementById('atrium-root').getBoundingClientRect(); return 'root ' + Math.round(r.left) + '+' + Math.round(r.width) + ' viewport ' + innerWidth + ' client ' + document.documentElement.clientWidth + ' scroll ' + document.documentElement.scrollHeight + '/' + innerHeight; })()

assertions.note: the browser window and the settings window

assertions.desc: the settings root fills the window at its initial size
the settings root fills the window after a resize
